title: [Cherry-pick][releases/v0.32.0rc][Bugfix] Support GLM-5.3-Flash PCP with torch.compile (from #20281)
body:
Cherry-pick of PR #20281 onto `releases/v0.32.0rc`.

Original PR: #20281
Original author: @bnbryan

---
### What this PR does / why we need it?

Fix GLM-5.3-Flash prefill failures when combining PCP with `torch.compile`.

Metadata-free profiling skips KDA's PCP gather/restore branches. Compiled execution then passes rank-local tensors to KDA while the request metadata describes global tokens, causing prefill to fail.

Wrap the PCP KDA path in a mutable-output custom op and register it as a piecewise split point. This keeps metadata-dependent operations active on every invocation and writes results into a stable buffer.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. GLM-5.3-Flash can process PCP prefill requests with compilation enabled.

For PCP>1, the KDA attention path executes eagerly inside the custom op, including projections and gather/restore. The surrounding backbone remains compiled. PCP=1 retains its existing compilation boundary.

### How was this patch tested?

- 50 focused unit tests passed, covering metadata-free export followed by live prefill/decode metadata,

- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/544f182d9f0c9bfe8bd7645525951d5e3692a542
